entities.name: Domènec Romera i Alcázar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Domingo Romera Alcázar was a Spanish politician. A member of the People's Alliance and later the People's Party, he served in the Senate of Spain from 1984 to 1986 and in the European Parliament from 1986 to 1994. He died in Lleida on 6 April 2022 at the age of 85.
